description: Let \(f:A\to B\) and \(g:B\to A\) be injections. Put \(C_0=A\setminus g[B]\), \(C_{n+1}=g[f[C_n]]\), and \(C=\bigcup_{n\in\mathbb N}C_n\). Define \(h(a)=f(a)\) on \(C\), and let \(h(a)\) be the unique \(b\in B\) with \(g(b)=a\) outside \(C\). Then \(h:A\to B\) is bijective.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.bernstein_map_bijective.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (f : α → β) (g : β → α)
  (hf : Function.Injective f) (hg : Function.Injective g) :
  Function.Bijective (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.bernsteinMap f g hg)
